scenes.narration: Welcome to Fresh and Quick. In the next few minutes we'll show you how to sign up, place your first order, track it to your door, and rate it.

scenes.label: Home page
scenes.narration: This is the home page. You can browse every restaurant and store without an account. The menu on the left lists the categories, like Restaurants, Grocery and Pet.

scenes.label: Sign In or Sign Up
scenes.narration: To order, you need an account. New here? Click Sign Up at the bottom of the left menu. Already registered? Click Sign In.

scenes.label: Sign up
scenes.narration: This is where you sign up. Each box tells you what goes in it.

scenes.label: Name, email and password
scenes.narration: Enter your full name, your email address, and a password of at least six characters.

scenes.label: Mobile number and address
scenes.narration: Next, your ten digit mobile number and your delivery address: address line one, an optional second line, city, state, and the six digit pincode. We check that the address is real, so please type it carefully.

scenes.label: Referral code, then Sign up
scenes.narration: If a friend invited you, enter their referral code here. Otherwise leave it blank. Then click Sign up.

scenes.label: Approval in progress
scenes.narration: After you sign up, you'll see this message. Every new account is reviewed by our team, and you'll get an email as soon as you're approved.

scenes.label: Waiting for approval
scenes.narration: If you try to log in before then, you'll see this reminder. Just wait for the approval email.

card.title: Our team reviews every new account
card.subtitle: You'll get an email once you're approved

scenes.narration: Behind the scenes, our team reviews your details and approves your account. You'll get an email as soon as it's done.

scenes.label: Log in
scenes.narration: Once you're approved, come back to the log in page, enter your email and password, and click Log in.

scenes.label: Your delivery location
scenes.narration: You're in. The address you gave at sign up is already set as your delivery location, at the top of the page. Stores are listed by distance from you.

scenes.label: Change delivery location
scenes.narration: To deliver somewhere else, click your location. Search for an address, drag the pin on the map, or use your current location, then click Save location.

scenes.label: Find a store
scenes.narration: Scroll to browse stores near you, or narrow the list with the cuisine buttons. Tap the heart on any store to save it to your Favorites.

scenes.label: A store's page
scenes.narration: This is a store's page. You'll see its rating and reviews from other customers, and you can search its menu.

scenes.label: Add dishes
scenes.narration: The menu is grouped by category. Click a category to jump to it, and click the plus button on a dish to add it to your basket. If a dish has choices, a window asks you to pick them first.

scenes.label: Your basket
scenes.narration: Your basket appears on the right. Change quantities, add a note for a dish, or a note for the whole order, like a gate code. Then click Checkout. A basket holds items from one store at a time.

scenes.label: Checkout: contact details
scenes.narration: At checkout, fill in who the order is for: a name, an email for order updates, and a mobile number.

scenes.label: Checkout: delivery address
scenes.narration: Then the delivery address. Search for it, or click Use my pinned location to fill it in from your saved location. Check the pincode before you continue.

scenes.label: Promo code and payment
scenes.narration: Have a promo code? Enter it and click Apply, and the discount shows straight away. Then choose how to pay: card, UPI, or cash on delivery. Payments in this demo are simulated, so no real money is charged.

scenes.label: Place your order
scenes.narration: Check your total, then click Place order.

scenes.label: Order status
scenes.narration: Your order page shows every step: placed, accepted, preparing, ready, on the way, and delivered. It updates by itself, so there's no need to refresh.

scenes.label: Live tracking
scenes.narration: Once a delivery partner is assigned, a live map shows the store, your address and your rider, with an estimated arrival time.

scenes.label: On the way
scenes.narration: When your order is picked up, a short animation follows your food to your door.

scenes.label: Rate your order
scenes.narration: After delivery, tell us how it went. Rate the store, and if you like each dish and the delivery. Add a comment or a photo, then click Submit review.

scenes.label: Your orders
scenes.narration: All your past orders are under Orders. Click Reorder to put the same dishes back in your basket in one click.

scenes.label: Ask Zippy
scenes.narration: Need help? Click Ask Zippy at the bottom right. Zippy answers your questions, finds dishes, checks on your order, and can even fill your basket for you.
That's it. Sign up, get approved, and enjoy your first order with Fresh and Quick.
